sources.snippet: Phi-3.5-mini-instruct is a 3.8 billion parameter transformer model with causal language modeling. It is based on the Phi-3 family architecture with improvements to instruction following and safety through supervised fine-tuning, proximal policy optimization, and direct preference optimization.
